mapper.sql: SELECT 'E' AS account_type, p.emp01_person_id AS account_id, c.sys01_company_id AS company_id, c.sys01_loc_nm AS company_code, c.sys01_company_nm AS company_name, p.emp01_emp_no AS login_id, p.emp01_kor_nm AS name, pw.pwd AS password, pw.age_days AS password_age_days, p.emp01_lock_yn AS lock_yn, t.emp03_trans_cd AS trans_code FROM emp01_person p INNER JOIN sys01_company c ON c.sys01_company_id = p.emp01_company_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT TO_DECRYPTS(sys25_pwd) AS pwd, COALESCE(DATE_PART('day', f_sysdate() - sys25_work_date), 0)::int AS age_days FROM sys25_password WHERE sys25_company_id = p.emp01_company_id AND sys25_person_id = p.emp01_person_id ORDER BY sys25_seq DESC LIMIT 1 ) pw ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT emp03_trans_cd FROM emp03_trans WHERE emp03_person_id = p.emp01_person_id AND emp03_trans_date <= f_sysdate() ORDER BY emp03_trans_date DESC, emp03_trans_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) t ON TRUE

SELECT 'M' AS account_type, u.sys02_user_id AS account_id, c.sys01_company_id AS company_id, c.sys01_loc_nm AS company_code, c.sys01_company_nm AS company_name, u.sys02_login_id AS login_id, u.sys02_kor_nm AS name, TO_DECRYPTS(u.sys02_passwd) AS password, 0 AS password_age_days, NULL AS lock_yn, NULL AS trans_code FROM sys02_user u INNER JOIN sys01_company c ON c.sys01_company_id = u.sys02_company_id
mapper.select: SELECT 'E' AS account_type, p.emp01_person_id AS account_id, c.sys01_company_id AS company_id, c.sys01_loc_nm AS company_code, c.sys01_company_nm AS company_name, p.emp01_emp_no AS login_id, p.emp01_kor_nm AS name, NULL AS password, NULL AS password_age_days, p.emp01_lock_yn AS lock_yn, NULL AS trans_code FROM emp01_person p INNER JOIN sys01_company c ON c.sys01_company_id = p.emp01_company_id WHERE p.emp01_company_id = #{companyId} ORDER BY (p.emp01_lock_yn = 'true') DESC, p.emp01_emp_no
